purpose: Describe an impulse or response that is impossible to suppress.
keywords: Verb negative stem + ずにはいられない; する → せずにはいられない
I could not help laughing when I heard that story.
When I see beautiful scenery, I cannot resist taking a photograph.
I was so worried about my friend that I had to get in touch.
formation: Verb negative stem + ずにはいられない; する → せずにはいられない
restrictions: Usually feelings drive the action; can describe another person through visible evidence.
mistake: It expresses cannot help doing, not an external duty like なければならない.
